en.name: Hell's Roulette
en.ability: After nominating, a player rolls a six-sided die: if that number has already been rolled, they die, and all rolled dice are removed.

zh.name: 地狱轮盘
zh.ability: 玩家在发起提名后要掷出一个六面骰：如果掷出的点数已存在，他死亡，并移除所有已掷的骰子。
